buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Non-disclosure of relevant information or furnishing of incorrect information, documents will attract dis qualification. 2. ISO certificate of OEM / Supplier must be submitted. 3. Agency/firm must have an establishment from Mumbai / Navi Mumbai region for quick technical support . Seller must provide shop and Establishment Certificate, GST Clearance Certificate & Udyam-Certificate al ong with the documents for valid workmanship compensation policy. 4. Valid Copy of the PAN no, as allotted by the Income Tax Department (Individual PAN for Proprietorship a nd for Firms/Agency etc. Firm/Company PAN should be submitted). 5. The Agency should be working on of at least 05 reputed government organizations. Attached work order copy of similar nature of work. 6. An affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper stating that the applicant is not facing any blacklisting from an establishment of Central Govt. or the State Govt. or the PSU for breach of agreement. 7. Bidders must offer products of Makes/OEMs having valid BIS license for manufacturing of tendered item. Bidders should submit documentary evidence failing which offer is liable to be ignored 8.Seller should have minimum 3 different experience of Tribunals. 9. Seller should upload EPFO and ESIC Challan with pay slip. 10. Seller should upload CRAC of all Contract. .
